channel.title: Cadence
channel.description: The demo site for Cadence: a zero-dependency static blog that builds, verifies and publishes itself on a schedule.

item.title: Setting it up
item.description: Four files to edit, one command to run, and a scheduled job that never needs you again.

item.title: What the verifier catches
item.description: The expensive failures on a static site are the silent ones. Nothing 500s. The post is simply never found.

item.title: The queue
item.description: Write thirty pieces on a Sunday. Publish one a day for a month, without touching anything.
